findings.location: …the beginning of a series by Brother Donald Brechbill on “discipleship”. Disciple has almost the same spelling as discipline.
findings.source_quote: "the beginning of a series by Brother Donald Brechbill on “discipleship”. Disciple has almost the same spelling as discipline."
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the English lexical words “Disciple” and “discipline” into Greek (they are substantive quoted words in the source). For example: replace "Ο όρος disciple (μαθητής) έχει σχεδόν την ίδια ορθογραφία με το discipline (πειθαρχία)." with a fully translated phrasing that preserves the author's point, e.g. "Ο όρος «disciple» (μαθητής) έχει σχεδόν την ίδια ορθογραφία με το «discipline» (πειθαρχία)." — or better, render both headwords in Greek: "Ο όρος «μαθητής» (disciple) έχει σχεδόν την ίδια ορθογραφία με την «πειθαρχία» (discipline)." Ensure the quoted substantive words are presented in Greek; if the original purposely discussed English spelling, retain an explicit note but also provide the Greek translation of those words.
findings.translation_quote: "Ο όρος disciple (μαθητής) έχει σχεδόν την ίδια ορθογραφία με το discipline (πειθαρχία)."
